svg.aria-label: Compression saves 1 to 3 percent; the risks cost more. Where Claude Code's cost goes across more than 400 real bkit transcripts: 69 percent is the model re-reading the system prompt, rules, tool list and conversation on every request; 4 percent is the model's own writing; 27 percent is big tool output, the only part a compressor can touch; the tools remove 1 to 3 percent of the bill. What you gain: 1 to 3 percent of the bill saved, big cuts on huge logs, prompt cache intact. What it costs you: wrong answers from compressed logs, broken code when lines are rewritten or cut, hidden content that costs tokens to fetch back, silent failures that turn compression off, a proxy that sees all your model traffic, and clashes with bkit's own setup.
